name: Aspartame
siboNotes: Aspartame is not fermented by gut bacteria and should not trigger SIBO symptoms. Generally well-tolerated for digestive sensitivities.
preparationTips: Use in cold beverages as heat can break down aspartame and reduce sweetness
Add to foods after cooking rather than during high-heat preparation
Start with small amounts as some people may be sensitive to artificial sweeteners
Store in cool, dry place to maintain stability
nutritionalHighlights: Does not affect blood sugar levels
Much sweeter than sugar so small amounts needed
